'''Darro''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War|renewed war]].

==Biography==
In [[3642 BBY]], he was stationed on [[Quesh]] where he targeted a large crane and attempted to disrupt the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] mining efforts. While he attempted to complete his mission, he tasked an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to plant explosive charges on the columns supporting the crane outside of the [[Quesh Venom Refinery]].
